long_biography.plain_text:
Lazzarini's corporate roles were concentrated largely in the family businesses built around the Merloni appliance group. A 2005 filing named her a director of Merloni Finanziaria International alongside Francesco Merloni and their children Paolo and Maria Francesca. Later Indesit governance reports recorded her own ordinary shares and life interests over shares belonging to daughters Claudia and Maria Francesca.

Those positions placed her within the family shareholder group rather than the day-to-day management of the listed appliance maker. She and other family members submitted a shareholder slate for Indesit's board in 2013, shortly before the company was sold to Whirlpool. Outside corporate governance, Lazzarini chaired Fabriano's Santa Cecilia choir and supported Rome's Accademia Nazionale di Santa Cecilia. After Francesco Merloni's death, she continued to represent the family at civic commemorations in Fabriano.
